name: pulsar-edit-mcp-server
description: Pulsar Editor MCP server — exposes editor tools to LLM clients via the Model Context Protocol

mcpServerPort.title: MCP Server Port
mcpServerPort.description: Listen on this port for MCP requests from your LLM client

apiEndpointPrefix.title: OpenAI API Endpoint
apiEndpointPrefix.description: The OpenAI compatible API completions endpoint prefix of your LLM when using the built-in chat - everything before /v1/chat/completions. (Requires Restart)

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: The API key for authenticating requests when using the built-in chat

maxTokens.title: Max Tokens (built-in chat)
maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the built-in chat LLM can return per response. Raise if responses get cut off.

autoStart.title: Auto-Start MCP Server on Pulsar Launch

showChatPanel.title: Show Chat Panel on Startup
showChatPanel.description: Open the built-in chat panel when Pulsar launches. Disable to save screen space if you use an external client.

toolGroups.title: Tool Groups (disable unused groups to save tokens)

edit.title: Edit Tools
edit.description: replace-text, replace-all, replace-document, replace-function-body, insert-text-at-line, insert-at-line, delete-line-range, get-selection

navigation.title: Navigation Tools
navigation.description: goto-line, open-file, list-open-files, get-surrounding-context, get-line-count, get-filename, get-full-path

fileOps.title: File Operation Tools
fileOps.description: read-file, read-lines, create-file, file-line-count, get-project-files, list-project-functions, get-includes-and-defines, replace-across-files

safety.title: Safety Tools
safety.description: checkpoint, restore-checkpoint, list-checkpoints, diff-preview, undo, redo

ghidra.title: Ghidra Tools
ghidra.description: list-functions, search-functions, get-function-body, get-xrefs, add-comment, get-function-list-with-comments
